display_information.name: Rally
display_information.description: A durable AI agent for cross-app work and personal automations.
display_information.long_description: Rally is a durable AI agent that carries work across Slack, Gmail, calendars, documents, issue trackers, and other connected services. Start a task from a DM, mention, shortcut, command, or message. The workspace bot subscribes to bounded message, reaction, file-share, channel, and membership events for explicit @Rally interactions, follow-ups in Rally-owned threads, and automations a workspace member deliberately configures. Events that match none of those uses are discarded, and Rally does not scrape, mirror, or build a second searchable Slack workspace. In response to a user-initiated Slack message or mention, Rally can use Slack's event-scoped Real-time Search API with keyword and semantic search to find relevant public-channel messages. Semantic Real-time Search requires a Slack Business+ or Enterprise+ plan. It can also read bounded context visible to the bot and, after confirmation where required, send bot-authored messages, add reactions, and create conversations. Slack members can start workspace-authorized tasks without linking a Rally account; those tasks use only shared workspace connections and remain attributed to the initiating Slack identity. Linking lets that member's own messages use personal authority and personal connectors. Rally keeps the task's own work history in Rally, shows status in the originating Slack thread, posts results there only after the complete turn is saved, and can deliver personal scheduled briefings to the user's Rally Agent DM. Personal Slack context and actions use the connected user's permissions. AI output can be incorrect; users should review important decisions and external actions.
